=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6492-6504 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_trend_single_table` takes `total` from the first page's `total_count` and never updates it. The new `more = (total > read) if total is not None else len(page_runs) >= TREND_PER_PAGE` therefore relies on a count that can be out of date.
  WHY: A new matching run created between the page-1 and page-2 GETs shifts offset pagination: one run is read twice and an older one is skipped, yet `read` still equals the stale `total`. The table is marked `history=complete` instead of truncated, so `trend_regression` can emit `regression=true` from incomplete history. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 judged the same race real but small in effect (one run out of more than 100) and reported it only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6500 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer says the pagination loop condition `more = (total > read) if total is not None else len(page_runs) >= TREND_PER_PAGE` "has been corrected in the latest iteration".
  WHY: The reviewer says the change correctly uses `total_count` when present, which prevents skipped runs or infinite loops. This is not a defect. The source gave no severity, so low is a placeholder.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:10838 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The existing test `test_classify_failure_shape_has_no_caller_yet` was renamed to `test_classify_failure_shape_only_called_by_run_time_trend`, against the constraint not to rename existing identifiers.
  WHY: Pytest selectors, CI invocations or scripts that use the old node ID no longer find the test. Three reviewers rated it NIT and minimax gave no severity. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash calls the rename defensible because the old premise is now false. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes the finding: no repository reference to `has_no_caller_yet` exists, and issue #8526 requires the change in meaning.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

(No task gaps reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:`_trend_single_table`, the `for run in page_runs:` loop (around lines 6494-6500)
  PROBLEM: Hardening suggestion, not a finding. Runs are not de-duplicated by `id`. A run created between the page-1 and page-2 requests shifts the offsets, so page 2 repeats one page-1 run. That run is counted twice in the day's `n` and median, and the table is still marked complete.
  WHY: Downgraded from the pass-1 MAJOR because, with `total_count >= 101`, one run barely moves the medians or `first_slow_day`. Suggested fix: keep a local `seen_ids: set[int]` and skip duplicates. Optionally set `table["reason"] = "history_truncated"` when a duplicate appears and `total` is not None. Estimated 4-6 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1.
- Every other review category: NONE. (3 related items)
  - Verified as correct: the current-run filter in `scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh` (`_heal_build_run_time_trend`, lines 3187-3205), which uses `.run_refs[0].run_id`, and the `more` logic at `scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py` line 6502.
  - Rejected: the pass-1 NIT about renaming the test. No repository reference to `has_no_caller_yet` exists, and issue #8526 requires the change.
  - Rejected: the pass-1 TASK_GAP. It is covered by `test_trend_truncated_history_never_sets_regression`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:`_trend_single_table`, lines 6492-6493 and 6502-6504 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Pagination keeps only the first page's `total_count` and uses it to decide whether the read is complete, even if the count changes on a later page.
  WHY: A matching successful run added between page requests can shift page 2 and leave out an older run. With an initial `total_count` of 200, the read stops at 200 and marks history complete, so regression detection runs on incomplete data.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:line 10838, `test_classify_failure_shape_only_called_by_run_time_trend` | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The change renames the existing test function `test_classify_failure_shape_has_no_caller_yet`, despite the task constraint not to change existing identifiers.
  WHY: Pytest selectors that use the old node ID no longer find the test.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:lines 6492-6503 in `_trend_single_table` | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `total` comes from page 1 only and is never refreshed. The rewritten `more` makes that stale value authoritative, so a run created between the page-1 and page-2 GETs causes one run to be read twice and an older one to be skipped while `read` still equals `total`.
  WHY: The old form marked this case `history=truncated`. The new form breaks at `if not more` and marks it `history=complete`, so `trend_regression` can emit `regression=true` from incomplete history. That breaks the issue's truncated-history criterion; the reviewer says the last run made the race worse.
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:line 10838 (`def test_classify_failure_shape_only_called_by_run_time_trend` — renamed from `test_classify_failure_shape_has_no_caller_yet` in the last run) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The rename goes against the linked issue's constraint "Do not change existing identifiers, log keys or markers" and silently drops the old pytest node ID as a selection target.
  WHY: This breaks node-ID selection, not runtime behaviour. The rename is defensible because the old premise is now false, but the deviation should be surfaced. The pre-push gate already discloses "Changed pre-existing assertions".
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:`_trend_single_table`, page loop (lines 6490-6510)
  PROBLEM: Hardening suggestion: `total` is fixed at its page-1 value. Refreshing it from each page's `total_count` narrows the window in which the count can go stale.
  WHY: Suggested fix: move `total = count` out from under `if total is None` and keep the isinstance guard. Estimated 2 lines; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
